title.en: Geography: Physical Geography of Tamil Nadu

text.en: Meena looked at the map of Tamil Nadu. "Hills, plains and a long coast," she said.

Tamil Nadu lies in the south-east of India, bordered by the Bay of Bengal and the Indian Ocean. Its relief includes the Western Ghats in the west, the Eastern Ghats and plateau regions, the central plains and the Coromandel coastal plain.
The major rivers are the Cauvery, Vaigai, Tamirabarani, Palar and Pennaiyar. The Cauvery delta is the most fertile. Tamil Nadu's soils are red, black, alluvial and laterite.
The climate is tropical with a hot summer and two monsoons. Forests are found on the hills, and the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve, Mudumalai and Anamalai protect wildlife. Palk Bay and the Gulf of Mannar are coastal wonders.
